localAdaptation: FreeBSD usr.bin/grep compiled to wasm32-wasip1 with Waffle's patched wasi-libc sysroot. patches/freebsd-grep-wasi.patch drops unused bzlib/zlib/sys/cdefs/sys/queue headers, disables FreeBSD-only mmap in favor of stdio read, initializes libc cwd from Waffle's runtime_proc.cwd import, aligns unset locale default to C, provides getprogname and WASI err/warn helpers, emulates REG_STARTEND via NUL-segmented musl regex(3) calls (matches spanning across an embedded NUL byte are not matched under musl regex), implements NUL-safe and locale-aware UTF-8 multibyte case folding via towupper() for literal patterns and non-empty literal ERE alternations (matching GNU grep and fastGrep under C and C.UTF-8), matches --include/--exclude globs against file basenames, short-circuits -q across operands/recursive walks and -L on first match per file, propagates mid-stream read errors separately from EOF with status 2, reports EISDIR on directory operands unless -r/-R/-d skip is active, distinguishes -r (command-line symlinks only) from -R (follow all symlinks), clears -h when -H appears later, suppresses -c counts when -l/-L is active, matches GNU -L exit status (0 if any line matched, 1 otherwise), and exits 141 on stdout EPIPE while reporting non-EPIPE stdout write failures with status 2.
